section: What about your son—was he also

conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: What about your son? Did he also disappear? I remember you went to the amusement park together, right?
Respondent: Minghao was right there the whole time, but he said he didn’t see where Xiyuan ran off to either.
Respondent: I don’t know how this could have happened...
Respondent: I questioned him for a long time, trying to get some clues from him... Maybe I pushed him too hard...
Respondent: The one who lost Xiyuan was clearly me...
Respondent: I’m sorry to them—to Xiyuan and Minghao... It’s all my fault.
Respondent: Could you please not question Minghao?
Respondent: He won’t say anything.
